proposedRule: From a univariate QQ-polynomial summand p(k), construct an antidifference G via SymPy Gosper (summation fallback), independently check G(k+1)-G(k)=p(k) as a polynomial identity, then combine integer endpoints with the hand-provided telescoping infrastructure rule.

notExtracted.reason: hand-provided combination rule is A1 infrastructure, not A2 novelty

novelty.note: Gosper, Faulhaber for p(k)=k^m, SymPy gosper_sum/summation, and the Math Anchor polynomial certificate checker already exist. This pack adapts them into a reusable experimental interface.
